metadata.changes: This PR's explicit-stack term_normalize.c plus the temporary syntax-depth guard patch below, copied into a disposable checkout. Both kernel files were restored to 89f73ea1 and the baseline WASM rebuilt afterward. Other guards, WASM memory/stack and query limits were unchanged. This diagnostic does not meet the production-depth gate.
metadata.comparison: All eight previously completing diagnostic cases retain their outcome, work, allocations and completed NF sizes. The 128-bit proof now completes; before this normalizer change it hit native recursion with no completed NF.
